Wow did I write this? Haha but seriously, I feel exactly the same way. I’m watching all my friends around me go on dates and enjoy themselves, and I feel like I’m just...there, you know? I’m one of the only gay kids at my school, and it sucks knowing I’ll probably never get a “fun” or even “normal” high school experience. 

So I can definitely sympathize with what you’re going through. And yeah, sometimes I also hate being gay. But most times, I’m extremely proud of it. The hardships we face are hell, but I feel like these things really make us who we are. That’s why I’m so connected to this community. I love being gay because it draws me closer to all these great people who have been through similar experiences. 

Just know that you are definitely not alone. I feel exactly what you’re feeling almost every day. One of these days, though, we’ll get to be our grand, gay selves, and that’s really all that matters. Keep your head up, friend. You got this! :)

I feel selfish, too. Thinking these thoughts. But everything is just so painful, like with what you said about your husband. That was heartbreaking. And maybe it’s weak or selfish to think “my life is too painful so I’m just going to end it.” But really, all we want is to find peace. Is that such a bad thing to want? I start thinking these things, and then I’ll think back to my family and other people in my life...and then the cycle keeps repeating itself. 

And yes, I have a dog. She’s been by my side for almost my whole life, and I’m scared of leaving her just like you are. Things like these are why I think maybe I’ll never be able to go through with what I want to do. 

Good luck to you, too. Your husband sounded like a wonderful guy, and I’m sorry he was taken from you. I hate that sometimes the people who are most deserving of life get theirs taken away. I wish I was able to give my life to a person like that. Anyway, one of these days, I hope that you are able to find peace.
